snippet.title: Ludo Fighters | Nobody Told the Board (Official Film)
snippet.description:
Get the game: https://ludofighters.com

It's older than anyone at this table. Your grandmother taught you on it. Then she beat you on it.

Then one night, the board woke up.

Ludo Fighters is the game you grew up with, reloaded. The rules you know are still here, but every piece is a soldier and every capture is a gun fight. Pick your squad, fight across six battlefields, plant hidden landmines, and bring your last soldier home. Play Lumi AI, pass the phone around, or battle friends online.

Your favourite game. Back in the fight.

▶ Website: https://ludofighters.com
▶ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ludofighters.app
▶ App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ludo-fighters-battle-board/id6832027707
